claims.name: Pico Firmware (CircuitPython)
claims.statement: Runs a continuous polling loop that owns and drives MidiKnob, MidiButton and VolumeLED instances.

attrs.responsibility: Poll physical controls, emit MIDI, react to incoming MIDI

claims.name: DJMixer (Mixxx Controller Script)
claims.statement: Subscribes to the Mixxx master gain engine control and translates its value into a MIDI CC message.

attrs.responsibility: Bridge Mixxx internal engine state to outbound MIDI

claims.name: Mixxx DJ Software
claims.statement: Third-party DJ application that the Pico Firmware exchanges MIDI Control Change and Note messages with, and that hosts the DJMixer.js controller script.

attrs.responsibility: Runs the actual mixing engine (gain, crossfader, PFL); the Pico is a peripheral to it

claims.name: Master Gain CC
claims.statement: MIDI Control Change, channel 1, CC7 - carries master volume gain, bidirectionally: knob-to-Mixxx and Mixxx-to-LEDs.

claims.name: Crossfader CC
claims.statement: MIDI Control Change, channel 1, CC8 - carries crossfader position, knob-to-Mixxx only.

claims.name: Headphone Cue Note
claims.statement: MIDI Note On/Off, channel 1, notes 20 and 21 - toggles PFL (pre-fader listen) for channel 1 or 2.

claims.name: DJ
claims.statement: A person operating the physical hardware - turning knobs, pressing headphone cue buttons, plugging in headphones - to control a live mix.

attrs.responsibility: Adjusts master volume, crossfader position and headphone cue while mixing

claims.name: DJ adjusts master volume
claims.statement: Turning the gain knob sends a MIDI CC to Mixxx, which applies the new gain and echoes a CC back so the Pico can light the volume LEDs.

attrs.trigger: DJ turns the Master Volume Gain knob
attrs.intent: Change the audible output level and show it on the LEDs

claims.name: DJ engages headphone cue
claims.statement: Pressing a cue button sends a MIDI Note to Mixxx, which routes that channel's audio to the headphone output.

attrs.trigger: DJ presses Headphone Cue Button 1 or 2
attrs.intent: Preview a channel privately before mixing it in

steps.action: send Note On, note 20 or 21, velocity 127

unknowns.looked_for: a failure or error-handling path (retry, timeout, disconnect recovery)
unknowns.conclusion: no error handling, USB-disconnect handling or retry logic present anywhere in staged code

unknowns.looked_for: a datastore or persisted state of any kind
unknowns.conclusion: none present - the system is entirely stateless in-memory (last-value comparison only)
